classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy in front; after the last note, wave a gentle 'shoo' and bow.
classes.childAction: Bow, play with bouncy fingers for teddy, then bow again.
classes.bridge: Light, bouncy fingers, like a fly dancing over the keys.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song lightly, start to end.
